Колко е средната сила F̄ … Δt = 10⁻³ s? Инерчният момент … I_x = mr²/4.“; candidate stops at „v = 5 m/s.“, drops the actual question, Δt and I_x, writes „кръгъзовец удар“, and invents „Отговор на монетата е:“ with two sub-questions (б) even asks for a mechanical work A and a radius) that are not printed.

checkerFindings.note: Info observation: problem 1 indeed has no printed figure and the candidate lists none. The path is off by one (problem 1 is /problems/0), but the observation itself is correct.

The finding describes a crop that „shows the Problem 3 trajectory diagram“ and calls the box [40,425,350,560] reasonable. GLM's candidate had no crops at all (schema-invalid), and every crop on disk at the time was mis-cut by the 270°-rotation bug, so the description is a pipeline artefact. The box as correctly cut does contain the problem-2 drawing, but it swallows two text lines, the caption and the first line of problem 3 — a defect the checker did not describe (it called the box reasonable). False positive caused by the mis-cut crops.

Describes a crop showing „text about Problem 5 microphones“ and calls box [105,625,350,735] reasonable. GLM had no crops; the described content is a mis-cut crop of another candidate. Correctly cut, the box contains the problem-3 drawing plus its caption and two lines of problem 4 (a real defect the checker did not identify). False positive caused by the mis-cut crops.

Claims the crop file is „empty (0 bytes)“ and the box [215,850,345,950] „appears reasonable“. Neither is a property of the box: no crop existed for GLM, and the box itself is wrong (it starts to the right of the loop and shows only problem-5 text), which the checker did not see.
